description: This file defines the CandidateHistoryDecorator class, which provides utility methods for managing and displaying candidate history records within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to associate candidate, vacancy, interview, and employee entities by ID, as well as retrieve formatted action descriptions and performed dates.

classes.name: CandidateHistoryDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for managing and presenting candidate history data, including setting related entities by ID and obtaining formatted action descriptions and dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a CandidateHistory entity.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity to the candidate history by candidate ID.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy entity to the candidate history by vacancy ID.

methods.name: setInterviewByInterviewId
methods.description: Associates an Interview entity to the candidate history by interview ID.

methods.name: setPerformedBy
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity as the performer of the action by employee ID.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryAction
methods.description: Returns the description of the candidate history action, formatted with capitalized words.

methods.name: getPerformedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted performed date of the candidate history record.
